bottleneck.description: KAIST-spinout medical exoskeleton maker (WalkON Suit, Angel Suit, Angel Legs) targeting paraplegia rehab; competes with Ekso Bionics, ReWalk, Cyberdyne, Wandercraft, Suit-X.

dependency.key_customers: Korean rehab hospitals, mobility-impaired patients, defense/industrial wearable pilots
dependency.key_suppliers: Maxon/Faulhaber-class precision motors, harmonic reducers, IMU/load-cell vendors, Korean precision sub-suppliers

editorial.notes: Angel Robotics is a niche rehabilitation exoskeleton vendor. Despite Cybathlon 2024 gold medal credentials, the medical exoskeleton market has multiple international competitors and the customer base (rehab clinics, individual patients) faces no switching cost beyond device-level qualification. The company is a downstream system integrator that buys actuators and sensors, with no upstream bottleneck role. Small-cap and pre-commercial scale further argues against any structural moat. LOW.
